author: toketrain
body:
Updated to version 2!
-Extended the map
-Added starting and ending towers for a more defined beginning and end
-Added better obstacles
-Made parts of map wider (kept a tiny narrow part for a bit harder game)
-Updated YAML


Hello! This is the first map I've made in a while, and my first Minotaur map. It has a teleport region, working yml, unique gameplay and decent aesthetics. It is for the new map contest. In the pictures you will see two tunnels/hallways right next to each other, one black and one white. This may seem odd, but the white one is the beginning, and the black is the end. the map wraps around and meets back. Since this is my first Minotaur map, I'm not exactly sure if this fits the criteria. Please leave any suggestions below. I'm happy to hear what you think.
The teleport region is the transfer from the light half to the dark half. You run through a wall (right before you hit the wall you are teleported) and go to the dark part of the map.

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
Im sorry, But the judges for the map building contest have decided to deny your map for the following reasons:

- Your map is rather narrow at parts. Making it wider would increase the quality of the gameplay greatly.
- The aesthetics of this map aren't up to Avicus standards in the judges opinion.  It's really dull and small and doesn't have all that much to it.
- Particular jumps are next to impossible on the map, and others are too small.
- However, On a more positive side, I really like the idea of how this map would work. If you revised the map based on the points that I made, I think this map would work out quite good.

Aesthetics 2/5
Gameplay 1/5 
Creativity 3/5

Thank you for submitting your map! I hope you participate in our next building competition!
